assistant|lake_michigan_trout_tips: Provided Lake Michigan trout fishing tips: tributaries (St. Joseph, Grand, Milwaukee rivers), structures (Chicago Light Shipwreck, Gary Reef, Saugatuck Reef), harbors/piers (Navy Pier, McKinley Marina, St. Joseph Harbor), depths 50-200 ft, temps 40-55°F
assistant|trout_spinner_lure_recommendat: Recommended spinner lures for Lake Michigan trout: Rapala Spinners, Mepps Aglia (1/16-1/4 oz), Blue Fox Vibrax (size 1-2), Rooster Tail (1/16-1/4 oz) in silver/gold/copper/chartreuse
assistant|montana_fly_fishing_recommenda: Recommended Montana fly fishing rivers: Big Horn, Madison, and Missouri Rivers; dry fly fishing with hoppers, stimulators, attractors; spring/fall for fewer crowds
assistant|colorado_fly_fishing_recommend: Recommended Colorado fly fishing rivers: Arkansas, Blue, and South Platte Rivers; noted tailwater fisheries; nymphing with pheasant tails, copper johns
assistant|fly_tying_resources: Recommended fly tying resources: The Fly Fishing Academy, Fly Tying 101, Fly Tying Forum, YouTube channels; books by Peter C. Whitlock, Mike Lawson, Tom Rosenbauer, Darrell Martin
assistant|bass_tackle_advice: Advised size 2 hooks and chartreuse plastic worms can work for largemouth bass; suggested green pumpkin/watermelon/June bug in murky water
assistant|rod_repair_advice: Advised on repair vs. replace decision for cracked rod: consider severity, age, repair cost ($20-$50 reasonable), budget; get professional assessment
